title: Repo Modal Move - Rework 1
outcome_summary: The two test regressions from the prior session were fixed, a shared `modal.js` utility was extracted to consolidate duplicate modal lifecycle code from `strategy.js` and `config-stores.js`, and the Strategy page repository table was updated to show a conditional "Store" column in multi-store mode. Supporting changes included a refreshTable race guard, a `doAddFolder` scope fix, a warning log in `handleGetRepo`, and documentation updates to `api-surface.md` and `file-tree.md`.
project_summary: This project resolves two test regressions and seven deferred items from the prior repo-modal-move session in the MCP GUI. It extracts a shared modal utility consolidating duplicate lifecycle code from strategy.js and config-stores.js, replaces the Folder Names column with a conditional Store column, and applies code-quality fixes including a refreshTable race guard and a doAddFolder scope correction. Documentation updates to api-surface.md and file-tree.md bring the project manifest back in sync with the implementation.
